deliverables: Fund Cardano builders through DAO governance processes
Require funded projects to track monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL
Operate KPI reporting through public dashboards with movement toward live on-chain data
Use an independent multisig administrator to validate milestones and disburse funds
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal initially received and administered by an independent council composed of dRep DAO members
request.what: Create or continue the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism to allocate treasury resources to builders advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The proposal says funded projects are required to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The proposal says the DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data.
The proposal claims the CB DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
The proposal states Round 1 funded 20 companies, involved 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, and achieved 83% governance participation.
The proposal states Round 2 funded 14 companies, added 18 new members, and achieved 88% member participation.

The proposal claims the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with transparency.
The proposal states an independent dRep DAO council will receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds before deployment, and oversee milestone-based disbursement through an independent multisig.

The proposal says ADA held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in auditable separate accounts, will not be delegated to a stake pool, and will be delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposal states the CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides a transaction link.

summary: The document describes a KPI-focused builder funding DAO with prior funding rounds, external references for governance history and repayment, milestone-based administration, and public KPI ambitions, but it does not state the requested ADA amount or a deadline in the supplied text.
